title: MedMemoryBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory in Personalized Healthcare
abstract: arXiv:2605.11814v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The large-scale deployment of personalized healthcare agents demands memory mechanisms that are exceptionally precise, safe, and capable of long-term clinical tracking. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on daily open-domain conversations, failing to capture the high-stakes complexity of real-world medical applications. Motivated by the stringent production requirements of an industry-leading health management agent serving tens of millions of active users, we introduce MedMemoryBench. We develop a human-agent collaborative pipeline to synthesize highly realistic, long-horizon medical trajectories based on clinically grounded, synthetic patient archetypes. This process yields a massive, expertly validated dataset comprising approximately 2,000 sessions and 16,000 interaction turns. translated_title: MedMemoryBench：面向个性化医疗保健的智能体记忆基准测试
translated_abstract: 个性化医疗保健智能体的大规模部署需要极其精确、安全且能够进行长期临床追踪的记忆机制。然而，现有的基准测试主要关注日常开放域对话，未能捕捉现实世界医疗应用中高风险的复杂性。受一个服务于数千万活跃用户的行业领先健康管理智能体的严苛生产需求启发，我们提出了MedMemoryBench。我们开发了一条人机协作流水线，基于具有临床依据的合成患者原型，构建了高度逼真的长时程医疗轨迹。这一过程产生了一个经过专家验证的大规模数据集，包含约2,000个会话和16,000个交互轮次。至关重要的是，MedMemoryBench突破了传统静态评估的局限，开创性地提出了一种“边构建边评估”的流式评估协议……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: MedMemoryBench是一个面向个性化医疗场景的智能体记忆评测基准，通过人机协作流水线构建了包含约2,000个会话、16,000轮交互的专家验证数据集，并首创“边构建边评估”的流式评估协议，弥补了现有基准无法反映真实医疗应用高风险复杂性的不足。
